title: Murder by Music
writer: Sandro Continenza, Federico De Urrutia, Julio Buchs
actors: Brett Halsey, Marilù Tolo, Fabrizio Moroni
plot: An off-duty sailor investigates the seemingly-unrelated suicides of his sister and her music teacher, and with the aid of the sister's friend and the teacher's nephew, discovers a link between their deaths and London's hippie scene.
